summary: Completed comprehensive SEO/WCAG accessibility testing of Zipplit pre-launch website redesign. All major requirements successfully implemented including structured data, meta tags, semantic HTML, WCAG compliance, static hero image, proper fonts, and mobile responsiveness. Static build capability verified working.

design_issues.issue: React warning about fetchPriority prop should be fetchpriority (lowercase)
design_issues.details: React console warning about DOM attribute casing - functional but generates console warning

minor_warnings.issue: Future flag warnings for v7 compatibility
minor_warnings.symptoms: Console warnings about v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath

passed_tests: HTML document has lang='en' attribute
Only one H1 element on page (proper heading hierarchy)
Skip-to-main-content link exists and becomes visible on focus (WCAG 2.4.1)
Semantic landmarks: header[role='banner'], main#main-content, footer[role='contentinfo']
Navigation uses semantic nav with aria-label='Main navigation'
All 6 sections have aria-labelledby pointing to valid heading IDs
All images have appropriate alt text (5 descriptive, 2 decorative)
All interactive elements (buttons, links) have accessible names
Newsletter email input has associated label via htmlFor/id
Form has aria-label='Newsletter signup'
Mobile hamburger has aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes
Hero section uses static image (not video) with fetchpriority='high'
DM Serif Display font loaded for headings (verified computed style)
'Zipplit' brand text uses sans-serif font (Nunito)
Meta tags present: description, og:title, og:description, twitter:card, canonical, theme-color
JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite) present in head
All navigation links scroll to correct sections
Career cards link to https://forms.gle/gzRLoJWTyQ5QEBkX7
Newsletter form submits and shows 'Subscribed!' confirmation
Mobile responsive at 390px width
Mobile hamburger menu visible and functional
Desktop navigation properly hidden on mobile
All 39 decorative elements have aria-hidden='true'
Prefers-reduced-motion support implemented (global.css)
Focus-visible styles working for keyboard navigation
Static build capability works (npm run build:client outputs to dist/spa/)
action_item_for_main_agent: Optional minor fix: Change fetchPriority to fetchpriority (lowercase) in hero image to eliminate React DOM attribute warning. All core functionality and requirements are working perfectly.
